value.rationale: The 10-node/15-plane incidence is intrinsic to a classical algebraic threefold, and its integral cokernel is a motivated obstruction to integral generation of node zero-cycles by plane incidence. An all-forms closed formula links Frobenius cycle parity with 2-primary torsion and shows a persistent Z/4 factor invisible to rational permutation-trace counts; the equivariant indicator-module lemma gives a structural reason, not merely a small numerical curiosity.
